title: Army Training Centres Are Exploiting Youth
description:
"Wake up at 4 AM or I’ll hit you with a stick!" – This isn’t discipline, it’s drama for the algorithm. Across India, dozens of so-called “Army training academies” are churning out viral reels, exploiting the desperation of aspirants who dream of wearing the uniform.

From fake motivation to public humiliation, these institutes focus more on views than values. Trainers make money, buy flashy cars, and grow their social media fame—while students are reduced to clickbait.

In this video, we expose how many Indian Army physical training institutes are fooling the youth, and why it's high time the Army itself steps in.
